versions.description: Rewards players who vote for this game server on the Takaro Server List. List the server publicly on its Public page first. Only verified votes are rewarded: the voter signed in with a Takaro account linked to their player, or with a linked Steam account. In-game items and commands for an offline player wait until they next join, or until they run the claimvote command.
